sentences.text:
By this application under Section 438 CrPC, the petitioner, an FIR named accused,
namely, Monirul Hoque has prayed for his pre arrest bail in Bilasipara P.S. Case No. 239/2022 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 445/2022 registered under Sections 376/420/406/498/506/34 IPC (earlier Dotma P.S. Case No. 13/2022 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 275/2022 registered under Sections 376/420/406/498/506/34 IPC).

The victim/informant on 28.02.2022 submitted a written complaint before the National Commission for Women against the FIR named accused persons, which in turn was forwarded to the Dotma Police Station of Kokrajhar District, where it was registered as Dotma P.S. Case No.
13/2022 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 275/2022 registered under Sections 376/420/406/498/506/34 IPC, which has been subsequently registered as Bilasipara P.S. Case No.
239/2022, corresponding to G.R. Case No. 445/2022 under Sections 376/420/406/498/506/34 IPC.

entities.text: Dotma Police Station of Kokrajhar District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
List on 31.05.2023, enabling Mr. Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam to place the up-to-date case diary of said Bilasipara P.S. Case No. 239/2022 registered under Sections 376/
420/ 406/ 498/506/34 IPC.

Till then (i.e., 31.05.2023), in the interim, in the event of arrest of the petitioner, namely, Monirul Hoque in said Bilasipara P.S. Case No. 239/2022, he shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 35,000/- with two local sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority on conditions that the petitioner (i) shall appear before the Investigating Officer of Bilasipara P.S. Case No. 239/2022 on or before 23.05.2023 during the office hours and thereafter,
as and when he is required for necessary investigation of said Bilasipara P.S. Case No. 239/2022; (ii)
shall not leave the territorial jurisdiction of the Bilasipara Police Station, without obtaining prior written permission from the concerned Investigating Officer of the case; (iii) shall not hamper with the investigation, or tamper with the evidence of the case and (iv) shall not, directly or indirectly,
make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.

Any violation of the aforesaid terms and conditions by the petitioner, named above, the interim pre-arrest bail granted to him in the aforementioned Bilasipara P.S. Case No. Page No.# 3/3 239/2022 shall stand automatically vacated.
